description: This file is a PHP class for the 'Featured' module controller in the OpenCart admin extension. It handles displaying and saving configuration for the Featured module within the admin panel.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Featured module's settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the Featured module, assembling breadcrumbs, module info, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the Featured module configuration via POST request, returning JSON success or error response.
